name: Sword of Love (Major Artifact)
body:
Slot none CL 18h Weight 4 lbs. Aura strong abjuration and enchantment

Alignment NG Ego 25 Senses 30 ft. (vision and hearing) Int 18 Wis 10 Cha 18 Communication speech/telepathy (Celestial, Common)

POWERS

The sword can cast create food and water, protection from evil, and cure serious wounds 3 times per day each.

The handle and blade of this beautiful sword are pure, shining gold magically reinforced, with rose-tinged reflexes. The Sword of Love is an intelligent +5 merciful longsword with a warm female personality. Any evil character trying to wield the blade suffers the effects of burning disarm (5d4 hp of damage), in addition to taking a negative level as long as they hold it.

A good wielder is under a permanent eagle’s splendor effect for as long as he holds the blade. Whenever the Sword of Love is used for total defense or fighting defensively, an attacking opponent (wielder’s choice) must make a DC 20 Will save or fall under the effects of a stay the hand spell, incapable to hit the wielder or any one other creature designated by the wielder. Once per day when the sword scores a critical hit, the target must make a DC 25 Will save or be affected by overwhelming presence, seeing the wielder as a wrathful angel or saint.

DESTRUCTION

The Sword of Love utterly crumbles into nothingness if used to kill the one true love of the wielder, knowingly and deliberately (not under any duress, blackmail, or enchantment effect).
